Professional Summary 
 
A results-driven Backend Engineer with almost 7 years of experience, specializing in technologies such as Java, Spring 
Boot, Spring ORM, Hibernate, Apache Kafka, Spark, AWS (including EMR, ECS, S3, Lambda, IAM, EC2, MSK), 
Terraform, and PCF. Possesses strong expertise in the Telecom and Fintech industries. 
 
Work Experience 
 
Senior Consultant at Ernst & Young LLP (October 2021 – Present)

on AWS EMR using Apache Spark, integrating seamlessly with Apache Kafka for real-time data processing in 
production environments.
 Designed, developed, and deployed RESTful APIs using Java and Springboot to enable seamless 
communication between microservices within an ECS cluster.
 Developed an AWS Lambda function to generate end-of-day reports by extracting data from a PostgreSQL

 Contributed in developing a Kafka Consumer application and deploy it on AWS ECS with ALB.
 Conducted a proof of concept (PoC) to implement SCRAM authentication on AWS MSK, enhancing secure 
access and authentication for Kafka clients.
 Provided continuous maintenance and support for production services, ensuring high availability, optimal 
performance, and quick resolution of issues.
 Experienced in system integration, including associated build and testing activities to ensure seamless 
functionality and reliability across integrated components.
 Collaborated closely with business analysts and product owners to gain a deep understanding of core service 
requirements and ensure alignment with business objectives.
 Actively participated in sprint planning as part of Agile project implementation, contributing to task 
prioritization, estimation, and ensuring alignment with project goals.
 Provided ongoing mentorship to junior technical staff, fostering their professional development and enhancing 
their skills in various technologies and best practices.

 Debugged multiple applications and UI pages.
